title: 3 Deep-Cut 2000s Animated Shows That Are Worth Watching From Beginning to End
content:
Animated revivals are coming in fast and furious these days, as various universes are making comebacks even with decades passing after their original finales. While shows like King of the Hill , Futurama , and The Amazing World of Gumball have all returned, there are some series that might never be lucky enough to return to the screen. Luckily, now feels like the right time to highlight three “deep-cut” shows that are worth watching from the start to their original end. While these shows might never return, they are very much worth your time if you are looking to revisit the animation of the aughts.

3.) Chowder

Cartoon Network has seen its fair share of big animated originals go on to receive serious glory, with the likes of Adventure Time, Regular Show , and The Powerpuff Girls being only three examples. Unfortunately, not every original from the cable network’s history will hit the same heights, which is especially tragic for Chowder . First arriving on Cartoon Network in 2007, the series garnered three seasons before coming to a close while focusing on its feline culinary student. Created by animator C.H. Greenblatt, Chowder’s world was unlike any other, and across its three-season run, the series blended humor with astonishing animation that often has to be seen to be believed. Throughout the entirety of the series, Chowder works well at not just delivering hilarity, but also creating unique characters that bounce off one another to make one of Cartoon Network’s best animated originals. Greenblatt has said in the past that he’d love to revisit this universe with a brand new prequel series, though Warner Bros originally shot down the idea, leaving it unlikely that we’ll see the new Chowder show arrive anytime soon.

2.) Spider-Man: The New Animated Series

It’s fair to say that X-Men ’97 has been a massive success as Marvel’s Merry Mutants have hit a new stride with its second season. Thanks to Xavier’s finest pulling in a lot of attention, many fans have been wondering if Fox’s Spider-Man: The Animated Series might be given a revival as well. What many might not know is that in 2003, a thirteen-episode animated series introduced the world to a surprising new take on the wallcrawler. Airing on MTV in the U.S., the CG animated series followed Peter Parker during his time at college, with How I Met Your Mother’s Neil Patrick Harris playing the part of your friendly neighborhood wallcrawler. The animated show takes place in a world quite like Sam Raimi’s original film trilogy, but brought in many villains that hadn’t made their way to the silver screen at that time. Villains like the Lizard, Electro, Kraven the Hunter, Silver Sable, and more all rounded out the roster, with even Michael Clarke Duncan returning to his role as the Kingpin from the Daredevil live-action film. If you’re a fan of Spider-Man , this long-lost MTV series might be well worth your time.

1.) Clerks : The Animated Series

Bringing back the likes of Dante, Randall, Jay, and Silent Bob from their original appearance in the live-action Clerks film, the hilarious six-episode series is a quick watch while also being gut-bustingly hilarious. On top of having many of the actors reprise their roles from the 1994 black-and-white comedy, the show even added in the villainous Leonardo Leonardo, played by Alec Baldwin. Even with only half a dozen installments to its name, you can still easily pick up Clerks: The Animated Series and find it relevant to today’s events. Kevin Smith was in charge of these animated adventures, landing before the film would receive two sequels that further explored the lives of Dante and Randall. There are so many moments from the series that have gained internet immortality thanks to the surge of memes sweeping the world wide web, proving that even with only six episodes to its name, Clerks still has staying power to this day.

title: Tomb Raider King Animated Series Reveals English Dub Cast, July 22 Debut
content:
The English cast includes:

• Monty Thompson as Jooheon

• Cassie Ewulu as Crow

• Alex Hom as Geonwoo

• Charles Nguyen as Julian

• Trey Upton as Kyungtae

• Hayden Daviau as Mother

• Drew Kocour as Student

• Chase Kloza as Seungwoo

• Max Hartman as Taejoon

The dub staff at Crunchyroll includes:

• Studio Producers: Justin Cook, Michael Harcourt, Nathanael Harrison

• Producer: Zach Bolton

• Adaptation Supervisor: Ben Phillips

• Adaptation: Jessica Sluys

• Adaptation Prep: Benjamin Tehrani

• Voice Director: Lee George

• Assistant Voice Director: Jonathan Rigg

• Talent Coordination: Tara A. Williams, Brittni Hurley

• Engineering Managers: Gino Palencia, Brandon Peters

• Engineer: Zachary Davis

• Mixer: Matt Grounds

The Korean-animated series began airing with a Japanese dub in Japan on the Fuji TV channel on July 8 under the localized title Tōkutsuō , and it also runs on Kansai TV , Tokai TV , BS Fuji , and Hokkaido Cultural Broadcasting Co., Ltd. Crunchyroll is streaming the series as it airs.

Tapas is releasing the webtoon in English digitally, and it describes the series:

Mysterious tombs appeared all over the world one day, each containing a relic which grants its owner supernatural abilities. Jooheon Suh is a tomb explorer, excavator, and raider. Betrayed by his employer, he's about to die at the hands of a powerful new relic when he suddenly finds himself 15 years in the past, before any relics or tombs made their debut. Driven by feelings of revenge, how will Jooheon use his knowledge of the future to become the Tomb Raider King ?

Seung Wook Woo is directing the animated series at STUDIO EEK , with Hyun-Jung Lee serving as character designer and chief animation director. Music is composed by Ju Young Kim . Korean girl group QWER perform the opening theme song "SHOW DOWN" and the ending theme song "To Be Continued."

Ize Press is also publishing the webtoon in print, and released the 15th volume on July 21.

The webtoon is based on SAN.G 's web novel series. An English version of the novel series is available on Tapas , Wuxiaworld , and Wattapad .

title: Dandadan Season 3’s Release Date Might Have Leaked (And It’s Sooner Than Expected)
content:
Dandadan Season 3 was reportedly in production since the second season of the anime came to an end in September 2025, and its production was finally confirmed in December 2025, alongside a 2027 premiere. While an exact release date and precise release window have yet to be announced, an apparent accidental leak from one of the anime’s major production committee members may have revealed when exactly the series is set to return. The potential leak stems from Animation Digital Network (ADN), a French-based company that serves as a primary distributor for the anime across major European regions while also handling its localization.

In a post commemorating the one-year anniversary of the Dandadan Season 2 episode featuring the transformed fight between Jiji and Okarun, ADN also expressed its excitement for the anime’s third season in January 2027. However, after fans picked up on the post and grew excited over the apparent release window, ADN deleted the tweet containing that information. Shortly afterward, the company published another post stating that it does not have a confirmed release date yet and that the mention was an oversight. While ADN retracted its statement, it strongly hints that Dandadan Season 3 will indeed premiere in Winter 2027, as it also aligns with the anime’s production pattern.

Dandadan Season 3 Might Premiere in January 2027

Since Animation Digital Network is heavily involved in the anime’s production committee, it may already have information that Dandadan Season 3 is indeed arriving in January 2027, making the post an accidental leak. What supports this claim is the fact that the Dandadan anime has consistently followed a production pattern of around a year before a new season arrives. The first season was announced in November 2023 and premiered 11 months later in October 2024. Meanwhile, the second season, which is considered the second cour of the first season, arrived just six months later. Therefore, since the third season has reportedly been in production since the second season ended in September last year, it suggests that a Winter 2027 release was always the plan.

That said, the release window has yet to be officially confirmed, and if the series takes longer, Science SARU may instead be planning a longer 24-episode season. If that is the case, the anime could arrive a year from now in July 2027 as part of the Summer season, running through the rest of the year. In any case, Dandadan Season 3 is confirmed to premiere sometime next year, meaning its official release window could be announced at any time. Based on ADN’s accidental post, the chances of a January 2027 premiere appear to be high. Dandadan Season 3 is set to be one of the biggest anime launches of 2027, and its arrival in January would help balance the year’s release schedule. Otherwise, the fandom could be overwhelmed by the stacked lineup of anime, especially in the latter half of the year.

title: Family Guy’s Stewie Spin-Off Expands Cast For 2027 Release
content:
Creating new series based in the world of Family Guy is nothing new for the long-running animated series, with The Cleveland Show being a prime example of Seth MacFarlane stretching his wings. Unsurprisingly, the Fox Animation powerhouse is returning to this well by focusing on, arguably, the most popular character of Quahog fame: Stewie Griffin. Set to arrive next year, Stewie will shine a light on the megalomaniac baby, and the spin-off has apparently found a good number of its cast. Needless to say, a few voice actors are joining the series that you might be familiar with.

In a new report from the outlet Deadline , Saturday Night Live Veterans Kenan Thompson and Vanessa Bayer are set to join the Stewie series, along with The Rookie’s Melissa O’Neil. Thompson is set to play Royal, one of Stewie’s new friends he makes at the preschool, while Bayer will take on the part of Stewie’s teacher, Morgan. Veterans of Family Guy itself, Mark Henry, Aaron Lee, and Jessica Lowe have also been added to the cast. For those who might not know the trio from name alone, Henry plays the part of Cleveland Brown in the main series, while taking on the part of BJ in Stewie , a “gossipy” classmate. Aaron Lee will take on the role of “Skunk,” the class turtle. Finally, Jessica Lowe will play the part of Stewie’s school rival, Caroline. Needless to say, it’s an impressive cast for the upcoming spin-off.

What We Know About The Stewie Spin-Off

As mentioned earlier, Stewie will arrive on Fox beginning in 2027 , but so confident is the network in this spin-off that it has already been confirmed for two seasons. While a third season isn’t confirmed, the youngest Griffin might be a spin-off that goes the distance, considering just how popular Stewie remains these days. Rather than seeing Stewie interacting with his fellow family members in the Griffin family, the spin-off is planning to take a different approach to the mad genius this time around, as Seth MacFarlane, of course, returns to the role.

While all the story details have yet to be revealed , and no trailer has arrived for Stewie as of the writing of this article, the plot will revolve around the titular baby being transferred to a new preschool. Now trapped within a far less hospitable school, Stewie will be dragging his teacher and classmates through adventures relying on the technology that has long allowed him to travel through space and time. Luckily, Stewie will still be a big part of Family Guy while the side story airs. A specific release date has yet to be revealed for the Quahog spin-off.

What do you think of the newcomers set to become a part of Stewie’s world next year? Leave a comment below and join the conversation now in the ComicBook Forum !

title: Crunchyroll Adds New Assassination Classroom Film
content:
Crunchyroll also began streaming the English dub for the second television anime season based on Yomu Mishima 's Trapped in a Dating Sim: The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs ( Otome Game Sekai wa Mob ni Kibishii Sekai Desu ) light novel series on Wednesday. The dub features a returning cast.

Assassination Classroom the Movie: Our Time opened in Japan on March 20 with Avex Film Labels distributing.

The cast members from the previous television anime reprise their roles for the film.

Masaki Kitamura ( After-School Hanako-kun , Gundam Evolve ) directed the film at Lerche . Makoto Uezu returned to pen the script for the film, and Aya Higami ( After-School Hanako-kun ) designed the characters. Singer-songwriter Sora Tomonari performs the film's theme song "Teacher." Mai Fuchigami , Aya Suzaki , Nobuhiko Okamoto , Ryōta Ōsaka , and Shintarō Asanuma perform the insert song "Machine Gun to Rashinban" (Machine Gun and Compass) as their respective characters, under the unit name 3-nen E-gumi Utatan, the unit name also used for the television anime songs.

The new film contains a full collection of episodes that were left out of the anime due to time constraints. The original manga's author Yūsei Matsui stated that the film is not just a 10th anniversary project, but is also a continuation of the main story.

Matsui's Assassination Classroom manga ran in Weekly Shonen Jump from 2012 to 2016. The manga inspired a 22-episode television anime series that aired in 2015, and a 25-episode second season that aired in 2016. An anime film then opened in Japan in November 2016.

Toonami began airing the anime's first season in August 2020, and started airing the second season in 2022.

Assassination Classroom also inspired two live-action films that opened in Japan in March 2015 and March 2016, respectively.

title: King of the Hill’s Season 15 Finale Perfectly Sets Up The Show’s Future
content:
Hank Hill and his family have returned to Arlen, Texas, as King of the Hill’s fifteenth season picks up where its predecessor left off. While the Hulu animated revival has mostly seen older iterations of Hank, Peggy, and Bobby, along with various supporting characters, many fans had questions about what came before. Luckily, the showrunners for the fifteenth season had answers. Thanks to the season finale, King of the Hill isn’t just in a good position to create compelling and hilarious new stories for Arlen; it will allow viewers to see a brand new side of Hank.

Warning. If you have yet to watch King of the Hill’s fifteenth season finale, be forewarned that we’ll be diving into serious spoiler territory . For those who might not know, the final episode of this highly anticipated season gave us a look into why Hank and Peggy ended up moving to Saudi Arabia. Thanks to Buck Strickland passing over Hank to be the new manager of Strickland Propane, the father of the Hill family quit on the spot and decided to look for employment elsewhere. Eventually returning to Texas, Hank was told in the recent finale that Strickland wasn’t exactly doing all that well thanks to the new management.

In the final moments of the finale , Hank is made the new manager/ownder of Strickland Propane, meaning that Hill’s days of retirement are now officially over. Hank routinely shone in his previous role of Assistant Manager, but now that he is in charge of the ship, seeing him transform Strickland Propane by being at the wheel is an interesting addition to the story. Hill’s love of propane has long been documented, with King of the Hill poking fun at just how much Hank fell in love with his work, so now that he is in charge, will this turn out to be an interesting detriment to both him and the family? Will he spend too much time working after trying to come to grips with retirement? There are some ripe storytelling elements to be explored, but luckily, Hulu has already confirmed the future for the animated revival.

The Hill Family’s Interesting Days Ahead

While Hank’s life might have changed the most thanks to the fifteenth season finale, this isn’t to say that other members of the Hill clan didn’t see some major differences as a result of this season. Specifically, Bobby and Connie are continuing to take their relationship to the next level , as the pair admit that they love one another after their long history. Ironically enough, perhaps the main character that hasn’t changed is Peggy, who is still retired as of the season’s end. This fact might just give us more hilarious storytelling in seasons sixteen and seventeen as Peggy tries to figure out what she should do now that Hank is going back to work and Bobby has “fled the coup.”

Earlier this month, we here at ComicBook.com had the opportunity to chat with season fifteen’s showrunner , Saladin Patterson, about how the series was planning to progress now that Hank is a working man once again. Luckily, Patterson hinted at the idea that the more things change, the more they stay the same: “You will not miss any alley guy shenanigans. If anything, there’s just the added complication now of Hank has to be involved in those things, and shenanigans at work. We also have figured out ways to bring work to the alley, that I won’t necessarily spoil now, but you know, that was something that we thought was important as well.” With the sixteenth season already written according to the showrunner, it’s full steam ahead for the Hulu animated series.

This fact might just give us more hilarious storytelling in seasons sixteen and seventeen as Peggy tries to figure out what she should do now that Hank is going back to work and Bobby has “fled the coup.”

Earlier this month, we here at ComicBook.com had the opportunity to chat with season fifteen’s showrunner , Saladin Patterson, about how the series was planning to progress now that Hank is a working man once again. Luckily, Patterson hinted at the idea that the more things change, the more they stay the same: “You will not miss any alley guy shenanigans. If anything, there’s just the added complication now of Hank has to be involved in those things, and shenanigans at work. We also have figured out ways to bring work to the alley, that I won’t necessarily spoil now, but you know, that was something that we thought was important as well.” With the sixteenth season already written according to the showrunner, it’s full steam ahead for the Hulu animated series.

title: Chainsmoker Cat Anime Casts Niina Nakabayashi
content:
The staff of the television anime of Nyan Nyan Factory 's Chainsmoker Cat ( Yanineko ) manga revealed on Wednesday that Niina Nakabayashi plays Jikaki Neko, who debuts in the preview for the fourth episode on Thursday:

The anime has two versions , an "Evil Dragon Unleashed" version that "respects the work's directorial intent" on some of the episodes, and an "On-Air" version that is made for terrestrial television broadcast. The "Evil Dragon Unleashed" version is available on the AT-X premium subscription channel and the AnimeFesta , DMM TV , Fuji TV On Demand , Hulu , Netflix , and Anime Times streaming services in Japan. ( AnimeFesta and Anime Times will also have the "On-Air" version.) 16 other streaming services only offers the "On-Air" version in Japan. OceanVeil streams the "Evil Dragon Unleashed" version of the anime.

The original manga contains toilet humor, gross-out comedy, and characters regularly consuming drugs and/or alcohol.

Seven Seas is releasing the manga in English, and it describes this comedy set in a world where humans, catgirls, and similar species co-exist:

Yani is a catgirl with a seriously bad smoking habit. She smokes so much that her apartment smells like ash and is littered with cigarette butts—and plenty of other trash! Every time she tries to quit, she becomes weak to the cravings and gives in almost instantly. Will she ever get her life together, or is she doomed to live as a chainsmoking slob forever?

The anime stars:

• Yūko Natsuyoshi as Yani Neko (real name Yaniko Satō)

• Misato Matsuoka as Yaku Neko (real name Yakuko Koshimaru)

• Yurie Funato as Hame Neko (real name Yurufuwa*Tenshi Hameko)

• Ayaka Shimizu as Kansai Neko (real name Kaoruko Nishi)

• Shiori Izawa as Aruko Neko (real name Aruko Sakai)

• Riko Akechi as Tatsurō Ochinpo

• Tetsu Inada as Landlord

• Rina Honnizumi as Imoko

Studio Lemon 's Taku Kimura ( Kairyū to Yūbinya-san , Star Wars: Visions ' "Tattooine Rhapsody") is directing the anime at Bibury Animation Studio , and Takashi Aoshima ( Himouto! Umaruchan , The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, Really Love You ) is writing the scripts. Riki Matsuura is designing the characters, and Keiichi Suzuki ( Saint Young Men , Tokyo Godfathers ) is composing the music. Rock band Wasureranneyo will perform the anime's opening theme song "Nanmonee," while Necry Talkie will perform the anime's ending theme song "Kemuri to Blue" (Smoke and Blue). Other staff members include:

• Art Directors: Atelier Musa's Yukiko Maruyama, Shōtarō Yoshino

• Color Key Artist: Yuiha Ōta

• Compositing Director of Photography: Hisashi Yonezawa

• Editing: Mutsumi Takemiya

• Sound Director: Takatoshi Hamano

• Sound Production: Magic Capsule

Nyan Nyan Factory has been serializing the manga in Kodansha 's Young Magazine , and Kodansha published the 12th compiled book volume on May 20. Seven Seas published the third volume in English on June 16.

title: Netflix is Finally Streaming 2026’s Biggest Anime So It’s The Perfect Time to Catch Up
content:
The biggest action anime of the year is now finally streaming with Netflix , and that means it’s now the perfect time to go back and catch up with it all. It’s been a great year for anime thus far , and there are still many major shows that fans are excited to check out through the rest of the Summer and Fall seasons. There are so many in fact that it can be tough to actually keep track of every major show that has already hit so far. That includes the biggest franchise out there right now.

Jujutsu Kaisen Season 3: The Culling Game Part 1 originally made its debut earlier this year, and wrapped up its run as one of the most explosive anime of the year . Now even more fans will get the chance to check it out and catch up with everything that’s happened so far as Jujutsu Kaisen Season 3 is now streaming with Netflix. It’s a new batch of episodes with English and Japanese language audio, so there’s no better time to jump in.

What’s Going on in Jujutsu Kaisen Season 3?

Jujutsu Kaisen Season 3 impressed fans with some of the biggest moments of the anime to date. That might have seemed impossible given everything that happened during the Shibuya Incident seen in the second season of the series, but the third season ratches things up even further as Kenjaku’s schemes enter their next phase . A deadly tournament begins with all sorts of new characters thrown into the fray, and many of them have unlocked their powers for the very first time.

The Culling Game arc not only introduces a whole new batch of characters who unlocked their powers as a result of the Shibuya Incident, but also resurrects a ton of past sorcerers from Sukuna’s era as part of Kenjaku’s bigger plan for the tournament. Yuji and Megumi get into their first major fights, but there are still many other fights yet to be seen as the Culling Game arc will be kicking off its second phase with the now in the works fourth season of the anime .

When Does Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4 Come Out?

Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4: The Culling Game Part 2 is now in the works, but has yet to confirm a release date or window as of the time of this writing. It will once again by produced by Studio MAPPA, but will feature new director Takeru Sato taking over from Shota Goshozono seen in the third season . Sato was an assistant director on the third season, so fans worried about the coming season likely don’t have much to worry about heading into what’s next.

The third season ends on a pretty big cliffhanger as it’s clear that the Culling Game has really only begun, so fans can expect to see all sorts of new fights in the next season. Though Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4 will likely make its debut with other streaming platforms long before it comes to Netflix, its streaming update for the third season is a promising step forward. Make sure to check it out.

title: The Live-Action Blue Lock Movie Releases New Preview
content:
Blue Lock wasted little time in becoming one of the biggest sports anime franchises of all time. First arriving in 2018 as a manga from creators Muneyuki Kaneshiro and Yusuke Nomura, the series hasn’t just continued to release new chapters to this day; it has also had a major impact on the soccer world. During the 2022 FIFA World Cup, Nomura teamed up with Japan’s national team to create uniforms modeled after the main team from Blue Lock . In another measure proving how far the sports franchise has come, a live-action movie is landing this year, releasing a new look for soccer fans.

For those who might not be aware, the first live-action Blue Lock movie is scheduled to arrive in Japan on August 7th next month. Starring the likes of Fumiya Takahashi, Kaito Sakurai, and Kyohei Takahashi as some of the biggest players from the anime, the film is set to be directed by Yusuke Taki. While not having previous experience working on major live-action anime adaptations, Taki has plenty of experience working on several Japanese television series. At present, Blue Lock’s upcoming film has not confirmed that it will be making its way to North America, and while it might not hit Western theaters, the popularity of the franchise means it’s a safe bet it will eventually make its way to the West. You can check out the new look at Blue Lock’s first live-action movie below.

Blue Lock’s Anime Controversy

Blue Lock has become an anime force of nature since Eight Bit Studio first brought it to life in 2022, though this fact didn’t mean that the adaptation has been able to completely dodge controversy. While the first season was widely accepted by the anime community, many viewers found themselves knocking season two for not living up to the same animation heights as its predecessor. An official reason was never shared as to why the animation suffered, according to most fans, though Blue Lock followers are crossing their fingers that season three will manage to turn the tide.

While this might be the first time that we are receiving a live-action Blue Lock movie, this is actually far from the first time that we’ve seen a live-action adaptation of the sports anime. In Japan, various anime franchises will routinely be recreated for the stage, and this soccer anime was no different. Blue Lock The Stage was first performed in 2023, bringing the story to audiences in a brand new way, eventually receiving more productions to adapt more stories in this universe. As of the writing of this article, there hasn’t been confirmation that Blue Lock will receive a live-action production in Hollywood, like Gundam and One Piece, but anything is possible when it comes to anime these days.

title: Toonami’s Wildest Anime Gets a New Physical Release Ahead of Season 2
content:
Since the Summer 2026 anime season is ongoing, several new anime series are being introduced to fans. The year is far from over, but fans have been introduced to dozens of exciting and unique shows. This also includes Rooster Fighter , one of the newest Toonami hits . The anime is also streaming on Netflix in various regions and became a surprising hit. Based on the action comedy manga written and illustrated by Shu Sakuratani, the anime premiered as part of the Spring 2026 lineup. While the manga is currently ongoing, the anime was brought to life by the underrated Snzigen studio. The first season reached its conclusion on June 22nd, 2026, and it’s already confirmed to release its Blu-ray DVD. While the details haven’t been confirmed yet, the official website of Viz Media announced that the Blu-ray is coming soon.

We can expect more updates on the Blu-ray release. Viz Media also confirms that the Blu-ray will be available on Crunchyroll Store. We can expect the Blu-ray DVD to come with its fair share of bonuses. Meanwhile, it’s already been a month since the first season’s finale , but there haven’t been any updates on the anime’s second season. The manga debuted in 2020, and it’s still ongoing, which means the animation studio has more than enough material to release a second season.

What Is Rooster Fighter About?

The story centers around a wandering rooster named Keiji who travels all over Japan and protects it from demonic threats. The story takes place three years after the mutant demons appeared in Japan. While many of these demons are harmless and even helpful, others run amok in the cities, causing trouble everywhere. The ones that are evil are created from humans suffering from emotional distress and trauma, allowing them to evolve into something more intelligent and dangerous.

While Keiji has made it his mission to defeat every threat to humanity he encounters, his ultimate goal is to find and kill the mutant dubbed “The White Demon” who killed his sister, Sara, to avenge her death. The anime takes a unique approach in presenting a rooster as the greatest defender of humanity who fights against opponents several times bigger than him. While the idea seems ridiculous at first glance, Keiji is often portrayed as an inspiring hero, not much different from most Shonen protagonists.

Rooster Fighter Is a Must-Watch For All Action Fans

Although the series has serious undertones, the anime is as hilarious as it could get . The charm of the story lies in the fact that it doesn’t shy away from incorporating mature content that surprisingly works in favor of its absurd comedy.

The first episode establishes a compelling backstory for its protagonist, adding real emotional weight to his character as he pursues revenge for his sister. Even so, the unhinged moments remain its strongest aspect, often leaning into parody, including Keiji performing a special projectile attack that clearly references Goku’s Kamehameha .
